segments.speaker: Others
segments.text: Thanks for joining. Today we plan the opening of the Second Bakery.

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: "Good, the landlord wants the signed lease back this week."

segments.speaker: Others
segments.text: Nadia, can you sign the lease and send it to the Landlord by Friday?

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: "Yes, I will send the signed lease on Friday."

segments.speaker: Others
segments.text: We decided to open on the first Monday of March.

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: "Fine, Omar, can you order the new oven for the kitchen?"

segments.speaker: Others
segments.text: Sure, I will order the new oven by tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Me
segments.text: "And I will write the job post for two bakers."
